protocol.description: Pre-registered Humanoid Matcher objective evaluation protocol.

strict_leave_one_music.definition: All segments, track metadata, and motions sharing the query music_id are removed before ranking. Queries are aggregated by music in statistics.

source_motion_sanity.note: Same-catalog source-track sanity check; not an unseen-music result.

acceptance.note: Unevaluated constraints are not silently counted as passes.

limitations: MuJoCo results are kinematic playback diagnostics, not torque-controlled balance or real-robot evidence.
FID/Div are emitted only when an explicitly identified SMPL/AIST++ feature bundle is supplied.
No objective metric fully replaces human judgement of naturalness or choreography aesthetics.
